title: Insufficient input validation in function `createVestingSchedule`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can lead to users never vesting their tokens  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a malicious/compromised admin or an error on his side  ## Description  The input arguments of the `createVestingSchedule` function are not sufficiently validated. Here are some problematic scenarios:  1. `_start` can be a timestamp that has already passed or is too far away in the future 2. `_cliff` can be too big, users won't be able to claim 3. 1 is a valid value for `duration`, the `!= 0` check is insufficient 4.
